actions.code: (() => { const page = Math.max(1, Number('{{page}}' || 1)); const keyword = String('{{searchKeyword}}' || '{{query}}' || '').trim(); const map = { '丝袜': 't_siwameinv.html', '丝袜美女': 't_siwameinv.html', '比基尼': 't_bijinimeinv.html', '泳装': 't_yongzhuangmeinv.html', '内衣': 't_neiyimeinv.html', '日本': 't_ribenmeinv.html', '韩国': 't_hanguomeinv.html', '国产': 't_zhongguomeinv.html', '欧美': 't_oumeimeinv.html', '亚洲': 't_yazhoumeinv.html', '写真': 't_xinganxiezhen.html', '性感写真': 't_xinganxiezhen.html' }; let category = map[keyword] || ''; if (!category && /^https?:\/\//i.test(keyword)) { try { const u = new URL(keyword); category = u.pathname.replace(/^\/+/, ''); } catch (e) {} } if (!category) category = 'model.html'; if (page <= 1) return '{{baseUrl}}/' + category; return '{{baseUrl}}/' + category.replace(/\.html$/i, '') + '_3_' + page + '.html'; })();

(() => { const base = '{{baseUrl}}'; const pick = (img) => { if (!img) return ''; const attrs = ['data-original','data-src','data-lazy-src','data-loadsrc','realsrc','src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const v = img.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (v && !/^data:/i.test(v)) { try { return new URL(v, base).href; } catch (e) { return v; } } } return ''; }; const title = (document.querySelector('.det-info h1')?.textContent || document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent || document.querySelector('title')?.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').replace(/[_-].*美图公社.*$/,'').trim(); const cover = pick(document.querySelector('#faded img, .det-img-item img, .det-topic img, .img-list img, img')); const desc = (document.querySelector('.det-info p')?.textContent || document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]')?.getAttribute('content') || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const tags = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.det-nav a')).map((el) => (el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()).filter(Boolean); return JSON.stringify({ title, cover, author: '', status: 'completed', description: desc, genre: tags.join(', ') }); })();

(() => { const base = '{{baseUrl}}'; const pages = []; const seen = []; const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(v, location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return v || ''; } }; const push = (v) => { if (!v || /^data:/i.test(v)) return; const url = abs(v); if (!/\.(webp|jpg|jpeg|png)(\?|#|$)/i.test(url)) return; if (seen.indexOf(url) >= 0) return; seen.push(url); pages.push({ index: pages.length, url, imageUrl: url }); }; const attr = (el) => { if (!el) return ''; const attrs = ['data-original','data-src','data-lazy-src','data-loadsrc','realsrc','src','href']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const v = el.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (v && !/^data:/i.test(v)) return v; } const style = el.getAttribute('style') || ''; const m = style.match(/url\(['"]?([^'")]+)['"]?\)/i); return m ? m[1] : ''; }; document.querySelectorAll('#faded img, .det-img-item img').forEach((el) => push(attr(el))); if (pages.length === 0) { document.querySelectorAll('.det-topic img, .img-list.det-topic img').forEach((el) => push(attr(el))); } return JSON.stringify(pages); })();
